text:
Ana (CS): Heads-up — Spectral Merchant usage dropped ~68% over the last 10 days, active seats 42 -> 13. Saw the main fall after last week's infra migration. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/usage/spectral-merchant?range=10d :warning:
Sam (AM): ugh. Is that across all teams or just a couple? Any billing churn alerts?
Ana (CS): Mostly the Purchasing and Pricing-engine teams. No billing alerts. Quick query I ran:

```
SELECT date, tokens_used, active_seats
FROM usage
WHERE account = 'spectral-merchant'
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 14;
```

Results show a steep drop starting 2026-03-10.
Jen (Solutions): I saw notes that they started evaluating a competitor last Friday. Olga — you saw that too, right?
Olga (Sales): Yep — Procurement flagged BrightServe as a potential cost win + easier procurement terms. I put convo notes in CRM: https://crm.redwood/spectral-merchant/notes. They liked BrightServe's pricing demo.
Mike (Product): Any sign of regressions from our side? Did any recent deploy affect embeddings or token counting?
Ana (CS): No error/latency spikes in Console. Traces look clean. Biggest drop is calls to embeddings endpoints.
Sam (AM): Plan suggestion: ASAP customer check-in + ops sync. Can we propose an 8-week pilot with a cost-focused config (quantized model + batching) to close the gap?
Jen (Solutions): I can put together a demo that shows ~20–30% token-cost reduction via batching + KV cache and tighter prompt templates. Need sample prompts and a usage slice.
Ana (CS): I'll extract sample prompts and top 10 frequent workflows by EOD. Olga — can you ask Sales Ops about an expedited pilot discount?
Olga (Sales): I can open a discount ticket. Tagging @Felix (SalesOps) in CRM. Also they asked for SOC2 during procurement. I'll attach our attestation.
RenewalBot: Renewal risk flag set to HIGH for account spectral-merchant. Renewal date: 2026-06-15. Last touch: 2026-02-28.
Sam (AM): Ok — propose 30-min customer call Wed 10:00am PT. Who can join?
Jen (Solutions): I can do Wed 10.
Olga (Sales): me too.
Ana (CS): I'll join. Prep checklist: 1) cost delta analysis 2) pilot scope & SLAs 3) mitigation if BrightServe offers feature X 4) exec intro.
Sam (AM): I'll book the meeting and use this agenda. Ana/Jen — drop materials in the shared drive: /drive/Spectral-merchant/pilot-ask.
Mike (Product): I'll prepare a short 1-pager on roadmap items relevant to their feature ask and compatibility notes vs BrightServe.
Ana (CS): Quick Q — do we need legal/RFP docs pre-call? Procurement mentioned SOC2 & DPA.
Olga (Sales): I'll attach SOC2 and the standard DPA template to the meeting invite.
Sam (AM): Action owners & deadlines: Ana — usage slices by EOD today; Jen — demo artifacts by EOD tomorrow; Olga — discount request + SOC2; Mike — 1-pager by EOD tomorrow. Tagging @CS-Leadership for visibility :eyes:.
Ana (CS): Thanks all — will post the raw usage CSV here when ready. :thumbsup:
Olga (Sales): I'll chase SalesOps now.
Jen (Solutions): I'll mock up two demo flows (low-cost and feature-parity) so we can A/B in the pilot.
Sam (AM): Good. If procurement pushes for an alternative vendor trial, propose a short SLA-backed pilot with clear success metrics (ctr, avg tokens per session, infra cost delta).
Ana (CS): noted. I'll annotate the metrics we should watch during the pilot.
RenewalBot: Note: account health channel updated to #account-health-high.
Sam (AM): End of thread for now — I'll schedule and share invite shortly.
